layer_status.mcl-core: Provisional Tier-0 semantic normalization assignments spanning 6 core message categories and associated opcode registries. C validator with overflow and truncation hardening.
layer_status.mcl-wire: Freestanding C99 reference codec. Bit-level encode/decode for 6 Tier-0 semantics. Extension framework present. Randomized fuzz decode. Known test vectors. Zero heap allocation.
layer_status.mcl-link: C99 reference state machine. 9-state lifecycle. Context install/authorize/compare. Wire major mask without narrowing. Coexistence tested with Wire.
layer_status.mcl-sdk: C99 reference SDK. Node init/reset, Tier-0 send/receive, Link lifecycle wrappers. Zero side-effect decode. Transport callback delivers raw Wire bytes only.
layer_status.mcl-ap: Analytical channel model (ISO 9613-1) + Experiment 001 (LAB/EXPERIMENTAL hosted binary FSK research testbed using host math and WAV I/O). No normative profile. AP-B0 NOT selected. Protocol-facing Wire, Link, and SDK libraries remain freestanding C99.
layer_status.mcl-ip: Draft binding specification only. No implementation.
layer_status.mcl-ble: Draft binding specification only. No implementation.
layer_status.mcl-uwb: Draft binding specification only. No implementation.

C0_static_registry.detail: semantic-codes-v0.2.json validated by tools/validate_registry.c with overflow and truncation hardening.

C1_canonical_encoding.detail: 6 Tier-0 semantics encode/decode bit-perfectly. Known test vectors retained in mcl-wire/tests/test_vectors.c.

C2_negative_decoding.detail: Truncated, malformed-opcode, noncanonical-padding, and oversized inputs tested. Randomized fuzz_decode exercised.

C3_link_state_tests.detail: 9-state lifecycle transitions, context install/reject in forbidden states, wire major mask boundary (0..UINT32_MAX), context compare.

C4_independent_interoperability.detail: No independent implementation exists to test against.

C5_ap_physical_profile_conformance.detail: No normative AP profile defined. Analytical model and experimental lab testbed only.

C6_device_ecosystem_robustness.detail: No multi-device, multi-transport, or ecosystem-scale testing performed.

E0_analytical.detail: ISO 9613-1 attenuation, spherical spreading, Doppler, serialization time, bitrate-equal-to-propagation. Boundary conditions tested (distance=0, negative, payload=0).

E1_deterministic_simulation.detail: Experiment 001: Binary FSK 300 baud, 48 kHz mono PCM, 4 preamble candidates (LFM chirp, Zadoff-Chu derived, PN m-sequence, frequency-diverse) evaluated with exact length invariant (N=4800, 0.1s), verified 7-bit m-sequence (period 127), equalized energy budgets, quadrature correlation magnitude, and preliminary small-sample empirical Pfa threshold calibration (target Pfa=0.010, exactly 100 noise trials per candidate). Corrected impairment harness with explicit enablement: measured AWGN power verified across 30, 20, 10, 5, 0 dB (at 0 dB SNR, noise power equals signal power within 0.5% and P_d=1.000, 12/12 payload CRC valid); post-filter colored noise power measured and scaled to requested SNR (30, 20, 15, 10, 5, 0 dB); band attenuation verified via pure sine probes (3000, 3800, 4000, 4200, 5000 Hz) with measured center notch attenuation of exactly -10.00 dB at 4000 Hz; hardened RIFF WAV chunk scanner and strict format rejection. Experiment 001 is a host-side research testbed using hosted C math/stdio/WAV; the protocol-facing Wire/Link/SDK C libraries remain freestanding C99.

E2_replay.detail: No recorded acoustic field captures replayed.

E3_controlled_over_air_frame.detail: Exact source WAV generated with symbol timing training sequence (exp001_e3_source.wav, SHA256: 1BCA567F7F68F5A18F41ADD8CDE03863C336D50F332097F8361262F56ECA1241). Offline WAV decoder implemented (decode_wav.c) with timing search and bit-perfect verification. Physical speaker->air->mic playback/record awaiting physical human acoustic session.
